stem: A team wants to watch a running test every day. Which way of monitoring keeps the result trustworthy?

options.text: Check the p-value daily and stop on the first day it falls below 0.05
Check the p-value daily and extend the test until it falls below 0.05
Look at nothing until the end, even if a guardrail shows serious harm
Watch guardrails for harm, but decide on success only at the planned end
